title: Administrator: role permissions match the expected set
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned the Administrator role.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Administrator role's Permission Summary (eye icon on the Roles list).
  2. Check the add/edit/delete areas, the Page Access toggles, the Work orders sub-settings, the View mode and the Cross-Cutting Toggles.
  3. Optionally log in as the user and spot-check a few of the role's typical tasks.
custom_expected: The Administrator permissions match the expected set: every add/edit/delete area full, all Page Access toggles on, all Settings sub-toggles on, See Financial Data on, View and Manage AP/AR Data on, View History Logs on, View mode Full View. Administrator is the single full-access role (Owner is merged into it) and is editable.
viu_status: Roles-API-Verified (permission set matches the live role); workflow spot-checks Blocked-UI
evidence: Administrator permission set confirmed live via GET /api/roles/{id} (roles-matrix-2026-07-13).
